title: A 500 MHz random cycle, 1.5 ns latency, SOI embedded DRAM macro featuring a three-transistor micro sense amplifier
query: IBM embedded DRAM micro sense amplifier local bitline 3-transistor Barth ISSCC 2008
supports: Barth et al. (IBM) built an SOI eDRAM macro with a three-transistor micro sense amplifier on each local bitline of about 32 cells, in which the bitline signal drives transistor gates directly. Related patent text says the many amplifiers cost array efficiency and the two main bitlines confine the scheme to embedded memory (via search snippet)

title: Application of resolution enhancement techniques at high-NA EUV for DRAM (SPIE 12495, 124950A)
query: interference lithography DRAM array honeycomb capacitor hole pattern cut mask complementary lithography
supports: Honeycomb capacitor holes and BLP with storage-node landing pad are the hardest DRAM patterning layers. The industry is weighing single-exposure EUV against a three-mask ArF-immersion solution. The search found no source applying interference lithography to DRAM hole layers (via search snippet)
